texts.lam.5.18: um des Berges Zion willen, daß er so wüst liegt, daß die Füchse darüber laufen.
texts.lam.5.19: Aber du, HERR, der du ewiglich bleibst und dein Thron für und für,
texts.lam.5.20: warum willst du unser so gar vergessen und uns lebenslang so gar verlassen?
texts.lam.5.21: Bringe uns, HERR, wieder zu dir, daß wir wieder heimkommen; erneuere unsre Tage wie vor alters!
texts.lam.5.22: Denn du hast uns verworfen und bist allzusehr über uns erzürnt.

texts.lam.1.1: Как одиноко сидит город, некогда многолюдный! он стал, как вдова; великий между народами, князь над областями сделался данником.
texts.lam.1.2: Горько плачет он ночью, и слезы его на ланитах его. Нет у него утешителя из всех, любивших его; все друзья его изменили ему, сделались врагами ему.
texts.lam.1.3: Иуда переселился по причине бедствия и тяжкого рабства, поселился среди язычников, и не нашел покоя; все, преследовавшие его, настигли его в тесных местах.
texts.lam.1.4: Пути Сиона сетуют, потому что нет идущих на праздник; все ворота его опустели; священники его вздыхают, девицы его печальны, горько и ему самому.
texts.lam.1.5: Враги его стали во главе, неприятели его благоденствуют, потому что Господь наслал на него горе за множество беззаконий его; дети его пошли в плен впереди врага.
texts.lam.1.6: И отошло от дщери Сиона все ее великолепие; князья ее - как олени, не находящие пажити; обессиленные они пошли вперед погонщика.
texts.lam.1.7: Вспомнил Иерусалим, во дни бедствия своего и страданий своих, о всех драгоценностях своих, какие были у него в прежние дни, тогда как народ его пал от руки врага, и никто не помогает ему; неприятели смотрят на него и смеются над его субботами.
texts.lam.1.8: Тяжко согрешил Иерусалим, за то и сделался отвратительным; все, прославлявшие его, смотрят на него с презрением, потому что увидели наготу его; и сам он вздыхает и отворачивается назад.
texts.lam.1.9: На подоле у него была нечистота, но он не помышлял о будущности своей, и поэтому необыкновенно унизился, и нет у него утешителя. "Воззри, Господи, на бедствие мое, ибо враг возвеличился!"
texts.lam.1.10: Враг простер руку свою на все самое драгоценное его; он видит, как язычники входят во святилище его, о котором Ты заповедал, чтобы они не вступали в собрание Твое.
texts.lam.1.11: Весь народ его вздыхает, ища хлеба, отдает драгоценности свои за пищу, чтобы подкрепить душу. "Воззри, Господи, и посмотри, как я унижен!"
texts.lam.1.12: Да не будет этого с вами, все проходящие путем! взгляните и посмотрите, есть ли болезнь, как моя болезнь, какая постигла меня, какую наслал на меня Господь в день пламенного гнева Своего?
texts.lam.1.13: Свыше послал Он огонь в кости мои, и он овладел ими; раскинул сеть для ног моих, опрокинул меня, сделал меня бедным и томящимся всякий день.
texts.lam.1.14: Ярмо беззаконий моих связано в руке Его; они сплетены и поднялись на шею мою; Он ослабил силы мои. Господь отдал меня в руки, из которых не могу подняться.
texts.lam.1.15: Всех сильных моих Господь низложил среди меня, созвал против меня собрание, чтобы истребить юношей моих; как в точиле, истоптал Господь деву, дочь Иуды.
texts.lam.1.16: Об этом плачу я; око мое, око мое изливает воды, ибо далеко от меня утешитель, который оживил бы душу мою; дети мои разорены, потому что враг превозмог.
texts.lam.1.17: Сион простирает руки свои, но утешителя нет ему. Господь дал повеление о Иакове врагам его окружить его; Иерусалим сделался мерзостью среди них.
texts.lam.1.18: Праведен Господь, ибо я непокорен был слову Его. Послушайте, все народы, и взгляните на болезнь мою: девы мои и юноши мои пошли в плен.
texts.lam.1.19: Зову друзей моих, но они обманули меня; священники мои и старцы мои издыхают в городе, ища пищи себе, чтобы подкрепить душу свою.
texts.lam.1.20: Воззри, Господи, ибо мне тесно, волнуется во мне внутренность, сердце мое перевернулось во мне за то, что я упорно противился Тебе; отвне обесчадил меня меч, а дома - как смерть.
texts.lam.1.21: Услышали, что я стенаю, а утешителя у меня нет; услышали все враги мои о бедствии моем и обрадовались, что Ты соделал это: о, если бы Ты повелел наступить дню, предреченному Тобою, и они стали бы подобными мне!
texts.lam.1.22: Да предстанет пред лице Твое вся злоба их; и поступи с ними так же, как Ты поступил со мною за все грехи мои, ибо тяжки стоны мои, и сердце мое изнемогает.
texts.lam.2.1: Как помрачил Господь во гневе Своем дщерь Сиона! с небес поверг на землю красу Израиля и не вспомнил о подножии ног Своих в день гнева Своего.
texts.lam.2.2: Погубил Господь все жилища Иакова, не пощадил, разрушил в ярости Своей укрепления дщери Иудиной, поверг на землю, отверг царство и князей его, как нечистых:
texts.lam.2.3: в пылу гнева сломил все роги Израилевы, отвел десницу Свою от неприятеля и воспылал в Иакове, как палящий огонь, пожиравший все вокруг;
texts.lam.2.4: натянул лук Свой, как неприятель, направил десницу Свою, как враг, и убил все, вожделенное для глаз; на скинию дщери Сиона излил ярость Свою, как огонь.
texts.lam.2.5: Господь стал как неприятель, истребил Израиля, разорил все чертоги его, разрушил укрепления его и распространил у дщери Иудиной сетование и плач.
texts.lam.2.6: И отнял ограду Свою, как у сада; разорил Свое место собраний, заставил Господь забыть на Сионе празднества и субботы; и в негодовании гнева Своего отверг царя и священника.
texts.lam.2.7: Отверг Господь жертвенник Свой, отвратил сердце Свое от святилища Своего, предал в руки врагов стены чертогов его; в доме Господнем они шумели, как в праздничный день.
texts.lam.2.8: Господь определил разрушить стену дщери Сиона, протянул вервь, не отклонил руки Своей от разорения; истребил внешние укрепления, и стены вместе разрушены.
texts.lam.2.9: Ворота ее вдались в землю; Он разрушил и сокрушил запоры их; царь ее и князья ее - среди язычников; не стало закона, и пророки ее не сподобляются видений от Господа.
texts.lam.2.10: Сидят на земле безмолвно старцы дщери Сионовой, посыпали пеплом свои головы, препоясались вретищем; опустили к земле головы свои девы Иерусалимские.
texts.lam.2.11: Истощились от слез глаза мои, волнуется во мне внутренность моя, изливается на землю печень моя от гибели дщери народа моего, когда дети и грудные младенцы умирают от голода среди городских улиц.
texts.lam.2.12: Матерям своим говорят они: "где хлеб и вино?", умирая, подобно раненым, на улицах городских, изливая души свои в лоно матерей своих.
texts.lam.2.13: Что мне сказать тебе, с чем сравнить тебя, дщерь Иерусалима? чему уподобить тебя, чтобы утешить тебя, дева, дщерь Сиона? ибо рана твоя велика, как море; кто может исцелить тебя?
texts.lam.2.14: Пророки твои провещали тебе пустое и ложное и не раскрывали твоего беззакония, чтобы отвратить твое пленение, и изрекали тебе откровения ложные и приведшие тебя к изгнанию.
texts.lam.2.15: Руками всплескивают о тебе все проходящие путем, свищут и качают головою своею о дщери Иерусалима, говоря: "это ли город, который называли совершенством красоты, радостью всей земли?"
texts.lam.2.16: Разинули на тебя пасть свою все враги твои, свищут и скрежещут зубами, говорят: "поглотили мы его, только этого дня и ждали мы, дождались, увидели!"
texts.lam.2.17: Совершил Господь, что определил, исполнил слово Свое, изреченное в древние дни, разорил без пощады и дал врагу порадоваться над тобою, вознес рог неприятелей твоих.
texts.lam.2.18: Сердце их вопиет к Господу: стена дщери Сиона! лей ручьем слезы день и ночь, не давай себе покоя, не спускай зениц очей твоих.
texts.lam.2.19: Вставай, взывай ночью, при начале каждой стражи; изливай, как воду, сердце твое пред лицем Господа; простирай к Нему руки твои о душе детей твоих, издыхающих от голода на углах всех улиц.
texts.lam.2.20: "Воззри, Господи, и посмотри: кому Ты сделал так, чтобы женщины ели плод свой, младенцев, вскормленных ими? чтобы убиваемы были в святилище Господнем священник и пророк?
texts.lam.2.21: Дети и старцы лежат на земле по улицам; девы мои и юноши мои пали от меча; Ты убивал их в день гнева Твоего, заколал без пощады.
texts.lam.2.22: Ты созвал отовсюду, как на праздник, ужасы мои, и в день гнева Господня никто не спасся, никто не уцелел; тех, которые были мною вскормлены и вырощены, враг мой истребил".
texts.lam.3.1: Я человек, испытавший горе от жезла гнева Его.
texts.lam.3.2: Он повел меня и ввел во тьму, а не во свет.
texts.lam.3.3: Так, Он обратился на меня и весь день обращает руку Свою;
texts.lam.3.4: измождил плоть мою и кожу мою, сокрушил кости мои;
texts.lam.3.5: огородил меня и обложил горечью и тяготою;
texts.lam.3.6: посадил меня в темное место, как давно умерших;
texts.lam.3.7: окружил меня стеною, чтобы я не вышел, отяготил оковы мои,
texts.lam.3.8: и когда я взывал и вопиял, задерживал молитву мою;
texts.lam.3.9: каменьями преградил дороги мои, извратил стези мои.
texts.lam.3.10: Он стал для меня как бы медведь в засаде, как бы лев в скрытном месте;
texts.lam.3.11: извратил пути мои и растерзал меня, привел меня в ничто;
texts.lam.3.12: натянул лук Свой и поставил меня как бы целью для стрел;
texts.lam.3.13: послал в почки мои стрелы из колчана Своего.
texts.lam.3.14: Я стал посмешищем для всего народа моего, вседневною песнью их.
texts.lam.3.15: Он пресытил меня горечью, напоил меня полынью.
texts.lam.3.16: Сокрушил камнями зубы мои, покрыл меня пеплом.
texts.lam.3.17: И удалился мир от души моей; я забыл о благоденствии,
texts.lam.3.18: и сказал я: погибла сила моя и надежда моя на Господа.
texts.lam.3.19: Помысли о моем страдании и бедствии моем, о полыни и желчи.
texts.lam.3.20: Твердо помнит это душа моя и падает во мне.
texts.lam.3.21: Вот что я отвечаю сердцу моему и потому уповаю:
texts.lam.3.22: по милости Господа мы не исчезли, ибо милосердие Его не истощилось.
texts.lam.3.23: Оно обновляется каждое утро; велика верность Твоя!
texts.lam.3.24: Господь часть моя, говорит душа моя, итак буду надеяться на Него.
texts.lam.3.25: Благ Господь к надеющимся на Него, к душе, ищущей Его.
texts.lam.3.26: Благо тому, кто терпеливо ожидает спасения от Господа.
texts.lam.3.27: Благо человеку, когда он несет иго в юности своей;
texts.lam.3.28: сидит уединенно и молчит, ибо Он наложил его на него;
texts.lam.3.29: полагает уста свои в прах, помышляя: "может быть, еще есть надежда";
texts.lam.3.30: подставляет ланиту свою биющему его, пресыщается поношением,
texts.lam.3.32: Но послал горе, и помилует по великой благости Своей.
texts.lam.3.33: Ибо Он не по изволению сердца Своего наказывает и огорчает сынов человеческих.
texts.lam.3.34: Но, когда попирают ногами своими всех узников земли,
texts.lam.3.35: когда неправедно судят человека пред лицем Всевышнего,
texts.lam.3.36: когда притесняют человека в деле его: разве не видит Господь?
texts.lam.3.37: Кто это говорит: "и то бывает, чему Господь не повелел быть"?
texts.lam.3.38: Не от уст ли Всевышнего происходит бедствие и благополучие?
texts.lam.3.39: Зачем сетует человек живущий? всякий сетуй на грехи свои.
texts.lam.3.40: Испытаем и исследуем пути свои, и обратимся к Господу.
texts.lam.3.41: Вознесем сердце наше и руки к Богу, сущему на небесах:
texts.lam.3.42: мы отпали и упорствовали; Ты не пощадил.
texts.lam.3.43: Ты покрыл Себя гневом и преследовал нас, умерщвлял, не щадил;
texts.lam.3.44: Ты закрыл Себя облаком, чтобы не доходила молитва наша;
texts.lam.3.45: сором и мерзостью Ты сделал нас среди народов.
texts.lam.3.46: Разинули на нас пасть свою все враги наши.
texts.lam.3.47: Ужас и яма, опустошение и разорение - доля наша.
texts.lam.3.48: Потоки вод изливает око мое о гибели дщери народа моего.
texts.lam.3.49: Око мое изливается и не перестает, ибо нет облегчения,
texts.lam.3.50: доколе не призрит и не увидит Господь с небес.
texts.lam.3.51: Око мое опечаливает душу мою ради всех дщерей моего города.
texts.lam.3.52: Всячески усиливались уловить меня, как птичку, враги мои, без всякой причины;
texts.lam.3.53: повергли жизнь мою в яму и закидали меня камнями.
texts.lam.3.54: Воды поднялись до головы моей; я сказал: "погиб я".
texts.lam.3.55: Я призывал имя Твое, Господи, из ямы глубокой.
texts.lam.3.56: Ты слышал голос мой; не закрой уха Твоего от воздыхания моего, от вопля моего.
texts.lam.3.57: Ты приближался, когда я взывал к Тебе, и говорил: "не бойся".
texts.lam.3.58: Ты защищал, Господи, дело души моей; искуплял жизнь мою.
texts.lam.3.59: Ты видишь, Господи, обиду мою; рассуди дело мое.
texts.lam.3.60: Ты видишь всю мстительность их, все замыслы их против меня.
texts.lam.3.61: Ты слышишь, Господи, ругательство их, все замыслы их против меня,
texts.lam.3.62: речи восстающих на меня и их ухищрения против меня всякий день.
texts.lam.3.63: Воззри, сидят ли они, встают ли, я для них - песнь.
texts.lam.3.64: Воздай им, Господи, по делам рук их;
texts.lam.3.65: пошли им помрачение сердца и проклятие Твое на них;
texts.lam.3.66: преследуй их, Господи, гневом, и истреби их из поднебесной.
texts.lam.4.1: Как потускло золото, изменилось золото наилучшее! камни святилища раскиданы по всем перекресткам.
texts.lam.4.2: Сыны Сиона драгоценные, равноценные чистейшему золоту, как они сравнены с глиняною посудою, изделием рук горшечника!
texts.lam.4.3: И чудовища подают сосцы и кормят своих детенышей, а дщерь народа моего стала жестока подобно страусам в пустыне.
texts.lam.4.4: Язык грудного младенца прилипает к гортани его от жажды; дети просят хлеба, и никто не подает им.
texts.lam.4.5: Евшие сладкое истаевают на улицах; воспитанные на багрянице жмутся к навозу.
texts.lam.4.6: Наказание нечестия дщери народа моего превышает казнь за грехи Содома: тот низринут мгновенно, и руки человеческие не касались его.
texts.lam.4.7: Князья ее были в ней чище снега, белее молока; они были телом краше коралла, вид их был, как сапфир;
texts.lam.4.8: а теперь темнее всего черного лице их; не узнают их на улицах; кожа их прилипла к костям их, стала суха, как дерево.
texts.lam.4.9: Умерщвляемые мечом счастливее умерщвляемых голодом, потому что сии истаевают, поражаемые недостатком плодов полевых.
texts.lam.4.10: Руки мягкосердых женщин варили детей своих, чтобы они были для них пищею во время гибели дщери народа моего.
texts.lam.4.11: Совершил Господь гнев Свой, излил ярость гнева Своего и зажег на Сионе огонь, который пожрал основания его.
texts.lam.4.12: Не верили цари земли и все живущие во вселенной, чтобы враг и неприятель вошел во врата Иерусалима.
texts.lam.4.13: Все это - за грехи лжепророков его, за беззакония священников его, которые среди него проливали кровь праведников;
texts.lam.4.14: бродили как слепые по улицам, осквернялись кровью, так что невозможно было прикоснуться к одеждам их.
texts.lam.4.15: "Сторонитесь! нечистый!" кричали им; "сторонитесь, сторонитесь, не прикасайтесь"; и они уходили в смущении; а между народом говорили: "их более не будет!
texts.lam.4.16: лице Господне рассеет их; Он уже не призрит на них", потому что они лица священников не уважают, старцев не милуют.
texts.lam.4.17: Наши глаза истомлены в напрасном ожидании помощи; со сторожевой башни нашей мы ожидали народ, который не мог спасти нас.
texts.lam.4.18: А они подстерегали шаги наши, чтобы мы не могли ходить по улицам нашим; приблизился конец наш, дни наши исполнились; пришел конец наш.
texts.lam.4.19: Преследовавшие нас были быстрее орлов небесных; гонялись за нами по горам, ставили засаду для нас в пустыне.
texts.lam.4.20: Дыхание жизни нашей, помазанник Господень пойман в ямы их, тот, о котором мы говорили: "под тенью его будем жить среди народов".
texts.lam.4.21: Радуйся и веселись, дочь Едома, обитательница земли Уц! И до тебя дойдет чаша; напьешься допьяна и обнажишься.
texts.lam.4.22: Дщерь Сиона! наказание за беззаконие твое кончилось; Он не будет более изгонять тебя; но твое беззаконие, дочь Едома, Он посетит и обнаружит грехи твои.
texts.lam.5.1: Вспомни, Господи, что над нами совершилось; призри и посмотри на поругание наше.
texts.lam.5.2: Наследие наше перешло к чужим, домы наши - к иноплеменным;
texts.lam.5.3: мы сделались сиротами, без отца; матери наши - как вдовы.
texts.lam.5.4: Воду свою пьем за серебро, дрова наши достаются нам за деньги.
texts.lam.5.5: Нас погоняют в шею, мы работаем, и не имеем отдыха.
texts.lam.5.6: Протягиваем руку к Египтянам, к Ассириянам, чтобы насытиться хлебом.
texts.lam.5.7: Отцы наши грешили: их уже нет, а мы несем наказание за беззакония их.
texts.lam.5.8: Рабы господствуют над нами, и некому избавить от руки их.
texts.lam.5.9: С опасностью жизни от меча, в пустыне достаем хлеб себе.
texts.lam.5.10: Кожа наша почернела, как печь, от жгучего голода.
texts.lam.5.11: Жен бесчестят на Сионе, девиц - в городах Иудейских.
texts.lam.5.12: Князья повешены руками их, лица старцев не уважены.
texts.lam.5.13: Юношей берут к жерновам, и отроки падают под ношами дров.
texts.lam.5.14: Старцы уже не сидят у ворот; юноши не поют.
texts.lam.5.15: Прекратилась радость сердца нашего; хороводы наши обратились в сетование.
texts.lam.5.16: Упал венец с головы нашей; горе нам, что мы согрешили!
texts.lam.5.17: От сего-то изнывает сердце наше; от сего померкли глаза наши.
texts.lam.5.18: Оттого, что опустела гора Сион, лисицы ходят по ней.
texts.lam.5.19: Ты, Господи, пребываешь во веки; престол Твой - в род и род.
texts.lam.5.20: Для чего совсем забываешь нас, оставляешь нас на долгое время?
texts.lam.5.21: Обрати нас к Тебе, Господи, и мы обратимся; обнови дни наши, как древле.
texts.lam.5.22: Неужели Ты совсем отверг нас, прогневался на нас безмерно?

texts.lam.1.1: Aleph. 1 Como assim solitaria está assentada aquella cidade, d’antes tão populosa! tornou-se como viuva; a que foi grande entre as nações, como a princeza entre as provincias, tornou-se tributaria!
texts.lam.1.2: Beth. 2 Continuamente chora de noite, e as suas lagrimas estão correndo pelas suas faces; não tem quem a console entre todos os seus amadores: todos os seus amigos se houveram aleivosamente com ella, se lhe tornaram inimigos.
texts.lam.1.3: Gimel. 3 Judah passou em captiveiro por causa da afflicção, e por causa da grandeza da sua servidão: ella habita entre as nações, não acha descanço: todos os seus perseguidores a alcançam entre as angustias.
texts.lam.1.4: Daleth. 4 Os caminhos de Sião pranteam, porque não ha quem venha á solemnidade; todas as suas portas estão assoladas; os seus sacerdotes suspiram: as suas virgens estão tristes, e ella mesma tem amargura.
texts.lam.1.5: He. 5 Os seus adversarios se lhe fizeram cabeça, os seus inimigos prosperam; porque o Senhor a entristeceu, por causa da multidão das suas prevaricações: os seus filhinhos vão em captiveiro adiante do adversario.
texts.lam.1.6: Vau. 6 E da filha de Sião foi-se toda a sua gloria: os seus principes ficaram sendo como veados que não acham pasto e caminham sem força adiante do perseguidor.
texts.lam.1.7: Zain. 7 Lembrou-se Jerusalem nos dias da sua afflicção, e das suas rebelliões, de todas as suas mais queridas coisas, que tivera dos tempos antigos: quando cahia o seu povo na mão do adversario, e ella não tinha quem a soccorresse, os adversarios a viram, e fizeram escarneo dos seus sabbados.
texts.lam.1.8: Heth. 8 Jerusalem gravemente peccou, por isso se fez instavel: todos os que a honravam, a desprezaram, porque viram a sua nudez; ella tambem suspirou e se voltou para traz.
texts.lam.1.9: Teth. 9 A sua immundicia está nas suas fraldas, nunca se lembrou do seu fim: por isso foi pasmosamente abatida, não tem consolador; vê, Senhor, a minha afflicção, porque o inimigo se engrandece.
texts.lam.1.10: Jod. 10 Estendeu o adversario a sua mão a todas as coisas mais preciosas d’ella; pois já viu ter entrado no seu sanctuario as nações ácerca das quaes mandaste que não entrassem na tua congregação.
texts.lam.1.11: Caph. 11 Todo o seu povo anda suspirando, buscando o pão, deram as suas coisas mais preciosas a troco de mantimento para refrescarem a alma: vê, Senhor, e contempla, que sou desprezivel.
texts.lam.1.12: Lamed. 12 Porventura não vos toca a todos os que passaes pelo caminho? attendei, e vêde, se ha dôr como a minha dôr, que se me fez a mim, com que me entristeceu o Senhor, no dia do furor da sua ira.
texts.lam.1.13: Mem. 13 Desde o alto enviou um fogo em meus ossos, o qual se assenhoreou: estendeu uma rede aos meus pés, fez-me voltar para traz, fez-me assolada e enferma todo o dia.
texts.lam.1.14: Nun. 14 Já o jugo das minhas prevaricações está atado pela sua mão, estão entretecidas, subiram sobre o meu pescoço, prostrou a minha força: entregou-me o Senhor nas mãos dos inimigos, não posso levantar-me.
texts.lam.1.15: Samech. 15 O Senhor atropellou todos os meus valentes no meio de mim; apregoou contra mim um ajuntamento, para quebrantar os meus mancebos: o Senhor pisou como n’um lagar a virgem filha de Judah.
texts.lam.1.16: Ain. 16 Por estas coisas eu ando chorando, e o meu olho, o meu olho se desfaz em aguas; porque se alongou de mim o consolador que devia restaurar a minha alma: os meus filhos estão assolados, porque prevaleceu o inimigo.
texts.lam.1.17: Pe. 17 Estende Sião as suas mãos, não ha quem a console: mandou o Senhor ácerca de Jacob que lhe fossem inimigos os que estão em redor d’elle; Jerusalem é como uma mulher immunda.
texts.lam.1.18: Tsade. 18 Justo é o Senhor, pois me rebellei contra a sua bocca: ouvi, pois, todos os povos, e vêde a minha dôr; as minhas virgens e os meus mancebos se foram para o captiveiro.
texts.lam.1.19: Koph. 19 Chamei os meus amadores, porém elles me enganaram: os meus sacerdotes e os meus anciãos expiraram na cidade; porque buscavam para si mantimento, para refrescarem a sua alma.
texts.lam.1.20: Resch. 20 Olha, Senhor, porque estou angustiada; turbadas estão as minhas entranhas, o meu coração está transtornado no meio de mim, porque gravemente me rebellei: de fóra me desfilhou a espada, de dentro está a morte.
texts.lam.1.21: Schin. 21 Bem ouvem que eu suspiro, porém não tenho quem me console: todos os meus inimigos que ouviram o meu mal folgam, porque tu o fizeste: trazendo tu o dia que apregoaste, então serão como eu.
texts.lam.1.22: Tau. 22 Venha todo o seu mal diante de ti, e faze-lhes como me fizeste a mim por causa de todas as minhas prevaricações; porque os meus suspiros são muitos, e o meu coração está desfallecido.
texts.lam.2.1: Aleph. 2 Como cobriu o Senhor de nuvens na sua ira a filha de Sião? derribou do céu á terra a gloria de Israel, e não se lembrou do escabello de seus pés, no dia da sua ira.
texts.lam.2.2: Beth. 2 Devorou o Senhor todas as moradas de Jacob, e não se apiedou: derribou no seu furor as fortalezas da filha de Judah, e as achegou á terra: profanou o reino e os seus principes.
texts.lam.2.3: Gimel. 3 Cortou no furor da sua ira toda a força de Israel: retirou para traz a sua dextra de diante do inimigo; e ardeu contra Jacob, como labareda de fogo que consome em redor.
texts.lam.2.4: Daleth. 4 Armou o seu arco como inimigo: firmou a sua dextra como adversario, e matou tudo o que era formoso á vista; derramou a sua indignação como fogo na tenda da filha de Sião.
texts.lam.2.5: He. 5 Tornou-se o Senhor como inimigo; devorou a Israel, devorou a todos os seus palacios, destruiu as suas fortalezas; e multiplicou na filha de Judah a lamentação e tristeza.
texts.lam.2.6: Vau. 6 E arrancou a sua cabana com violencia, como a de uma horta, e destruiu a sua congregação: o Senhor em Sião poz em esquecimento a solemnidade e o sabbado, e na indignação da sua ira rejeitou com desprezo o rei e o sacerdote.
texts.lam.2.7: Zain. 7 Rejeitou o Senhor o seu altar, detestou o seu sanctuario; entregou na mão do inimigo os muros dos seus palacios: levantaram grita na casa do Senhor, como em dia de solemnidade.
texts.lam.2.8: Heth. 8 Intentou o Senhor destruir o muro da filha de Sião: já estendeu o cordel sobre elle, não retirou a sua mão de devorar; já fez gemer o antemuro e o muro juntamente, já estão enfraquecidos.
texts.lam.2.9: Teth. 9 Já subverteram as suas portas, destruiu e quebrou os seus ferrolhos: estão entre as nações o seu rei e os seus principes: já não ha lei, nem acham visão alguma do Senhor os seus prophetas.
texts.lam.2.10: Jod. 10 Estão assentados por terra, estão calados os anciãos da filha de Sião; lançam pó sobre as suas cabeças, cingiram saccos: as virgens de Jerusalem abaixam as suas cabeças até á terra.
texts.lam.2.11: Caph. 11 Já se consumiram os meus olhos com lagrimas, turbadas estão as minhas entranhas, o meu figado se derramou pela terra por causa do quebrantamento da filha do meu povo; porquanto desfallecem o menino e a creança de mama pelas ruas da cidade.
texts.lam.2.12: Lamed. 12 A suas mães dizem: Onde ha trigo e vinho? quando desfallecem como o ferido pelas ruas da cidade, derramando-se a sua alma no regaço de suas mães.
texts.lam.2.13: Mem. 13 Que testemunho te trarei? a quem te compararei, ó filha de Jerusalem? a quem te assimilharei, para te consolar a ti, ó virgem filha de Sião? porque grande é como o mar a tua quebradura; quem te sarará?
texts.lam.2.14: Nun. 14 Os teus prophetas virão para ti, vaidade e loucura, e não manifestaram a tua maldade, para desviarem o teu captiveiro: antes viram para ti cargas vãs e expulsões.
texts.lam.2.15: Samech. 15 Todos os que passam pelo caminho palmeiam sobre ti com as mãos, assobiam e meneiam as suas cabeças, sobre a filha de Jerusalem, dizendo: É esta a cidade de que se dizia: Perfeita é em formosura, o gozo de toda a terra.
texts.lam.2.16: Pe. 16 Todos os teus inimigos abrem as suas boccas sobre ti, assobiam, e rangem os dentes; dizem: Já a temos devorado; pois este é o dia que esperavamos; já o achámos, já o vimos.
texts.lam.2.17: Ain. 17 Fez o Senhor o que intentou; cumpriu a sua palavra, que mandára desde os dias da antiguidade: derrubou, e não se apiedou; e alegrou o inimigo sobre ti, exaltou o poder dos teus adversarios.
texts.lam.2.18: Tsade. 18 O coração d’elles clamou ao Senhor: Ó muralha da filha de Sião: derrama lagrimas como um ribeiro, de dia e de noite; não te dês descanço, nem parem as meninas de teus olhos.
texts.lam.2.19: Koph. 19 Levanta-te, dá vozes de noite no principio das velas; derrama o teu coração como aguas diante da face do Senhor: levanta a elle as tuas mãos, pela vida de teus filhinhos, que desfallecem de fome á entrada de todas as ruas.
texts.lam.2.20: Resch. 20 Vê, ó Senhor, e considera a quem fizeste de tal modo: porventura comerão as mulheres o fructo das suas entranhas, as creanças que trazem nos braços? ou matar-se-ha no sanctuario do Senhor o sacerdote e o propheta?
texts.lam.2.21: Schin. 21 Jazem em terra pelas ruas o moço e o velho, as minhas virgens e os meus mancebos vieram a cair á espada: tu os mataste no dia da tua ira; degolaste e não te apiedaste.
texts.lam.2.22: Tau. 22 Convocaste os meus temores em redor como n’um dia de solemnidade; nem houve alguem no dia da ira do Senhor que escapasse, nem quem ficasse: aos que trouxe nas mãos e sustentei o meu inimigo os consumiu.
texts.lam.3.1: Aleph. 3 Eu sou aquelle homem que viu a afflicção pela vara do seu furor.
texts.lam.3.2: A mim me guiou e levou ás trevas e não á luz.
texts.lam.3.3: Devéras se tornou contra mim e virou a sua mão todo o dia.
texts.lam.3.4: Beth. 4 Fez envelhecer a minha carne e a minha pelle, quebrantou os meus ossos.
texts.lam.3.5: Edificou contra mim, e me cercou de fel e trabalho.
texts.lam.3.6: Assentou-me em logares tenebrosos, como os que estavam mortos ha muito.
texts.lam.3.7: Gimel. 7 Cercou-me de sebe, e não posso sair: aggravou os meus grilhões.
texts.lam.3.8: Ainda quando clamo e grito, elle exclue a minha oração.
texts.lam.3.9: Cercou de sebe os meus caminhos com pedras lavradas, divertiu as minhas veredas.
texts.lam.3.10: Daleth. 10 Fez-se-me como urso de emboscada, um leão em esconderijos.
texts.lam.3.11: Desviou os meus caminhos, e fez-me em pedaços; deixou-me assolado.
texts.lam.3.12: Armou o seu arco, e me poz como alvo á frecha.
texts.lam.3.13: He. 13 Faz entrar nos meus rins as frechas da sua aljava.
texts.lam.3.14: Fui feito um objecto de escarneo a todo o meu povo, de canção sua todo o dia.
texts.lam.3.15: Fartou-me de amarguras, embriagou-me de absintho.
texts.lam.3.16: Vau. 16 Quebrou com pedrinhas de areia os meus dentes; abaixou-me na cinza.
texts.lam.3.17: E affastaste da paz a minha alma; esqueci-me do bem.
texts.lam.3.18: Então disse eu: Já pereceu a minha força, como tambem a minha esperança no Senhor.
texts.lam.3.19: Zain. 19 Lembra-te da minha afflicção e do meu pranto, do absintho e do fel.
texts.lam.3.20: Minha alma certamente d’isto se lembra, e se abate em mim.
texts.lam.3.21: D’isto me recordarei no meu coração; por isso esperarei.
texts.lam.3.22: Heth. 22 As misericordias do Senhor são a causa de não sermos consumidos; porque as suas misericordias não teem fim.
texts.lam.3.23: Novas são cada manhã; grande é a tua fidelidade.
texts.lam.3.24: A minha porção é o Senhor, diz a minha alma; portanto esperarei n’elle.
texts.lam.3.25: Teth. 25 Bom é o Senhor para os que se ateem a elle, para a alma que o busca.
texts.lam.3.26: Bom é esperar, e aguardar em silencio a salvação do Senhor.
texts.lam.3.27: Bom é para o homem levar o jugo na sua mocidade.
texts.lam.3.28: Jod. 28 Assentar-se-ha solitario, e ficará em silencio; porquanto Deus o poz sobre elle.
texts.lam.3.29: Ponha a sua bocca no pó, dizendo: Porventura haverá esperança.
texts.lam.3.30: Dê a sua face ao que o fere; farte-se de affronta.
texts.lam.3.31: Caph. 31 Porque o Senhor não rejeitará para sempre.
texts.lam.3.32: Antes, se entristeceu a alguem, compadecer-se-ha d’elle, segundo a grandeza das suas misericordias.
texts.lam.3.33: Porque não afflige nem entristece aos filhos dos homens do seu coração.
texts.lam.3.34: Lamed. 34 Para atropellar debaixo dos seus pés a todos os presos da terra.
texts.lam.3.35: Para perverter o direito do homem perante a face do Altissimo.
texts.lam.3.36: Para subverter ao homem no seu pleito; porventura não o veria o Senhor?
texts.lam.3.37: Mem. 37 Quem é aquelle que diz, e assim acontece, quando o Senhor o não mande?
texts.lam.3.38: Porventura da bocca do Altissimo não sae o mal e o bem?
texts.lam.3.39: De que se queixa logo o homem vivente? queixe-se cada um dos seus peccados.
texts.lam.3.40: Nun. 40 Esquadrinhemos os nossos caminhos, e investiguemol-os, e voltemos para o Senhor.
texts.lam.3.41: Levantemos os nossos corações com as mãos a Deus nos céus, dizendo:
texts.lam.3.42: Nós prevaricámos, e fomos rebeldes; por isso tu não perdoaste.
texts.lam.3.43: Samech. 43 Cobriste-nos da tua ira, e nos perseguiste; mataste, não perdoaste.
texts.lam.3.44: Cobriste-te de nuvens, para que não passe a nossa oração.
texts.lam.3.45: Por cisco e rejeitamento nos pozeste no meio dos povos.
texts.lam.3.46: Pe. 46 Todos os nossos inimigos abriram contra nós a sua bocca.
texts.lam.3.47: Temor e cova vieram sobre nós, assolação e quebrantamento.
texts.lam.3.48: Correntes de aguas derramou o meu olho pelo quebrantamento da filha do meu povo.
texts.lam.3.49: Ain. 49 O meu olho manou, e não cessa, porquanto não ha descanço,
texts.lam.3.50: Até que attente e veja o Senhor desde os céus.
texts.lam.3.51: O meu olho move a minha alma, por causa de todas as filhas da minha cidade.
texts.lam.3.52: Tsade. 52 Como ave me caçaram os que são meus inimigos sem causa.
texts.lam.3.53: Arrancaram a minha vida na masmorra, e lançaram pedras sobre mim.
texts.lam.3.54: Derramaram-se as aguas sobre a minha cabeça; eu disse: Estou cortado.
texts.lam.3.55: Coph. 55 Invoquei o teu nome, Senhor, desde a mais profunda cova.
texts.lam.3.56: Ouviste a minha voz; não escondas o teu ouvido ao meu suspiro, ao meu clamor.
texts.lam.3.57: Tu te chegaste no dia em que te invoquei; disseste: Não temas.
texts.lam.3.58: Resch. 58 Pleiteaste, Senhor, os pleitos da minha alma, remiste a minha vida.
texts.lam.3.59: Viste, Senhor, a injustiça que me fizeram; julga a minha causa.
texts.lam.3.60: Viste toda a sua vingança, todos os seus pensamentos contra mim.
texts.lam.3.61: Schin. 61 Ouviste o seu opprobrio, Senhor, todos os seus pensamentos contra mim,
texts.lam.3.62: Os ditos dos que se levantam contra mim e as suas imaginações contra mim todo o dia.
texts.lam.3.63: Observa-os a elles ao assentarem-se e ao levantarem-se; eu sou a sua canção.
texts.lam.3.64: Tau. 64 Rende-lhes recompensa, Senhor, conforme a obra das suas mãos.
texts.lam.3.65: Dá-lhes ancia de coração, maldição tua sobre elles.
texts.lam.3.66: Na tua ira persegue-os, e desfal-os de debaixo dos céus do Senhor.
texts.lam.4.1: Aleph. 4 Como se escureceu o oiro! como se mudou o oiro fino e bom! como estão espalhadas as pedras do sanctuario ao canto de todas as ruas!
texts.lam.4.2: Beth. 2 Os preciosos filhos de Sião, avaliados a puro oiro, como são agora reputados por vasos de barro, obra das mãos do oleiro!
texts.lam.4.3: Gimel. 3 Até as vaccas marinhas abaixam o peito, dão de mamar aos seus filhos; porém a filha do meu povo fez-se cruel como as abestruzes no deserto.
texts.lam.4.4: Daleth. 4 A lingua do mesmo que mama de sêde fica pegada ao seu paladar: os meninos pedem pão, e não ha quem lh’o reparta.
texts.lam.4.5: He. 5 Os que comiam delicadezas agora desfallecem nas ruas; os que se crearam em carmezim abraçam o esterco.
texts.lam.4.6: Vau. 6 E maior é a maldade da filha do meu povo do que o peccado de Sodoma, a qual se subverteu como n’um momento, sem que trabalhassem n’ella mãos algumas.
texts.lam.4.7: Zain. 7 Os seus nazireos eram mais alvos do que a neve, eram mais brancos do que o leite, eram mais roxos de corpo do que os rubis, e mais lisos do que a saphira.
texts.lam.4.8: Heth. 8 Mas agora escureceu-se o seu parecer mais do que o negrume, não se conhecem nas ruas: a sua pelle se lhes pegou aos ossos, seccou-se, tornou-se como um pau.
texts.lam.4.9: Teth. 9 Os mortos á espada mais ditosos são do que os mortos á fome; porque estes se esgotam como traspassados, por falta dos fructos dos campos.
texts.lam.4.10: Jod. 10 As mãos das mulheres compassivas cozeram seus filhos: serviram-lhes de comida no quebrantamento da filha do meu povo.
texts.lam.4.11: Caph. 11 Deu o Senhor cumprimento ao seu furor: derramou o ardor da sua ira, e accendeu fogo em Sião, que consumiu os seus fundamentos.
texts.lam.4.12: Lamed. 12 Não creram os reis da terra, nem todos os moradores do mundo, que entrasse o adversario e o inimigo pelas portas de Jerusalem.
texts.lam.4.13: Mem. 13 Pelos peccados dos prophetas, pelas maldades dos seus sacerdotes, que derramaram o sangue dos justos no meio d’ella,
texts.lam.4.14: Nun. 14 Erraram cegos nas ruas, andavam contaminados de sangue; e, não podendo, levantavam as extremidades das suas roupas.
texts.lam.4.15: Samech. 15 Chamavam-lhes: Desviae-vos, é immundo; desviae-vos, desviae-vos, não toqueis, certo é que já voaram, tambem erraram: disseram entre as nações: Nunca mais morarão aqui.
texts.lam.4.16: Pe. 16 A face do Senhor os apartou, nunca mais tornará a olhar para elles: não reverenciaram a face dos sacerdotes, nem se compadeceram dos velhos.
texts.lam.4.17: Ain. 17 Emquanto subsistiamos, ainda desfalleciam os nossos olhos, esperando o nosso vão soccorro: olhavamos attentamente pela gente que não podia livrar.
texts.lam.4.18: Tsade. 18 Espiaram os nossos passos, de maneira que não podiamos andar pelas nossas ruas: está chegado o nosso fim, estão cumpridos os nossos dias, porque é vindo o nosso fim.
texts.lam.4.19: Coph. 19 Os nossos perseguidores foram mais ligeiros do que as aves dos céus: sobre os montes nos perseguiram, no deserto nos armaram ciladas.
texts.lam.4.20: Resch. 20 O respiro dos nossos narizes, o ungido do Senhor, foi preso nas suas covas; do qual diziamos: Debaixo da sua sombra viveremos entre as nações.
texts.lam.4.21: Schin. 21 Regozija-te, e alegra-te, ó filha de Edom, que habitas na terra de Uz; porém ainda até a ti passará o copo; embebedar-te-has, e te descobrirás.
texts.lam.4.22: Tau. 22 Já se cumpriu a tua maldade, ó filha de Sião, nunca mais te levará em captiveiro: visitará a tua maldade, ó filha de Edom, descobrirá os teus peccados.
texts.lam.5.1: Lembra-te, Senhor, do que nos tem succedido: considera, e olha o nosso opprobrio.
texts.lam.5.2: A nossa herdade passou a estranhos, e as nossas casas a forasteiros.
texts.lam.5.3: Orphãos somos sem pae, nossas mães são como viuvas.
texts.lam.5.4: A nossa agua por dinheiro a bebemos, por preço vem a nossa lenha.
texts.lam.5.5: Padecemos perseguição sobre os nossos pescoços: estamos cançados, e nós não temos descanço.
texts.lam.5.6: Aos egypcios estendemos as mãos, e aos syros, para nos fartarem de pão.
texts.lam.5.7: Nossos paes peccaram, e já não são: nós levamos as suas maldades.
texts.lam.5.8: Servos dominam sobre nós; ninguem ha que nos arranque da sua mão.
texts.lam.5.9: Com perigo de nossas vidas trazemos o nosso pão, por causa da espada do deserto.
texts.lam.5.10: Nossa pelle se ennegreceu como um forno, por causa do ardor da fome.
texts.lam.5.11: Forçaram as mulheres em Sião, as virgens nas cidades de Judah.
texts.lam.5.12: Os principes foram enforcados pelas mãos; as faces dos velhos não foram reverenciadas.
texts.lam.5.13: Aos mancebos tomaram para moer, e os moços tropeçaram debaixo da lenha.
texts.lam.5.14: Os velhos cessaram de se assentarem á porta, os mancebos de sua canção.
texts.lam.5.15: Cessou o gozo de nosso coração, converteu-se em lamentação a nossa dança.
texts.lam.5.16: Já caiu a corôa da nossa cabeça; ai agora de nós, porque peccámos.
texts.lam.5.17: Portanto desmaiou o nosso coração, por isto se escureceram os nossos olhos.
texts.lam.5.18: Pelo monte de Sião, que está assolado, as raposas andam por elle.
texts.lam.5.19: Tu, Senhor, permaneces eternamente, e o teu throno de geração em geração.
texts.lam.5.20: Porque te esquecerias de nós para sempre? porque nos desampararias tanto tempo?
texts.lam.5.21: Converte-nos, Senhor, a ti, e nos converteremos: renova os nossos dias como d’antes.
texts.lam.5.22: Porque nos rejeitarias totalmente? te enfurecerias contra nós em tão grande maneira?

texts.lam.1.1: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary.
texts.lam.1.2: She weepeth bitterly in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.
texts.lam.1.3: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.
texts.lam.1.4: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.
texts.lam.1.5: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the LORD hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.
texts.lam.1.6: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty hath departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
texts.lam.1.7: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none helped her: the adversaries saw her, and mocked at her sabbaths.
texts.lam.1.8: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yes, she sigheth and turneth backward.
texts.lam.1.9: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she hath been wonderfully abased: she had no comforter. O LORD, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified himself.
texts.lam.1.10: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.
texts.lam.1.11: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for food to relieve the soul: see, O LORD, and consider; for I am become vile.
texts.lam.1.12: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there is any sorrow like my sorrow, which hath fallen upon me, with which the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
texts.lam.1.13: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate and faint all the day.
texts.lam.1.14: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, and come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the Lord hath delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise.
texts.lam.1.15: The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, as in a wine-press.
texts.lam.1.16: For these things I weep; my eye, my eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.
texts.lam.1.17: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, and there is none to comfort her: the LORD hath commanded concerning Jacob, that his adversaries should be around him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.
texts.lam.1.18: The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
texts.lam.1.19: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and my elders resigned their breath in the city, while they sought their food to relieve their souls.
texts.lam.1.20: Behold, O LORD; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; my heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.
texts.lam.1.21: They have heard that I sigh: there is none to comfort me: all my enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done it: thou wilt bring the day that thou hast called, and they shall be like me.
texts.lam.1.22: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do to them, as thou hast done to me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
texts.lam.2.1: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven to the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!
texts.lam.2.2: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought them down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and its princes.
texts.lam.2.3: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devoureth on every side.
texts.lam.2.4: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.
texts.lam.2.5: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.
texts.lam.2.6: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the LORD hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and in the indignation of his anger hath despised the king and the priest.
texts.lam.2.7: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the LORD, as in the day of a solemn feast.
texts.lam.2.8: The LORD hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.
texts.lam.2.9: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes are among the Gentiles: the law is no more: her prophets also find no vision from the LORD.
texts.lam.2.10: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
texts.lam.2.11: My eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.
texts.lam.2.12: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers' bosom.
texts.lam.2.13: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?
texts.lam.2.14: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not revealed thy iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.
texts.lam.2.15: All that pass by, clap their hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call the Perfection of beauty, the Joy of the whole earth?
texts.lam.2.16: All thy enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up: certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.
texts.lam.2.17: The LORD hath done that which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused thy enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thy adversaries.
texts.lam.2.18: Their heart cried to the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thy eye cease.
texts.lam.2.19: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thy heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands towards him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger at the head of every street.
texts.lam.2.20: Behold, O LORD, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?
texts.lam.2.21: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men have fallen by the sword; thou hast slain them in the day of thy anger; thou hast killed, and not pitied.
texts.lam.2.22: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors around, so that in the day of the LORD'S anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up, hath my enemy consumed.
texts.lam.3.1: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
texts.lam.3.2: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.
texts.lam.3.3: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.
texts.lam.3.4: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
texts.lam.3.5: He hath built against me, and compassed me with gall and labor.
texts.lam.3.6: He hath set me in dark places, as they that are dead of old.
texts.lam.3.7: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
texts.lam.3.8: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
texts.lam.3.9: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
texts.lam.3.10: He was to me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.
texts.lam.3.11: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
texts.lam.3.12: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
texts.lam.3.13: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
texts.lam.3.14: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.
texts.lam.3.15: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
texts.lam.3.16: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
texts.lam.3.17: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
texts.lam.3.18: And I said, My strength and my hope hath perished from the LORD:
texts.lam.3.19: Remembering my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
texts.lam.3.20: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
texts.lam.3.21: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
texts.lam.3.22: It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
texts.lam.3.23: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
texts.lam.3.24: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
texts.lam.3.25: The LORD is good to them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
texts.lam.3.26: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
texts.lam.3.27: It is good for a man that he should bear the yoke in his youth.
texts.lam.3.28: He sitteth alone, and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.
texts.lam.3.29: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if there may be hope.
texts.lam.3.30: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
texts.lam.3.31: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:
texts.lam.3.32: But though he causeth grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
texts.lam.3.33: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
texts.lam.3.34: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
texts.lam.3.35: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
texts.lam.3.36: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.
texts.lam.3.37: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?
texts.lam.3.38: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
texts.lam.3.39: Why doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
texts.lam.3.40: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
texts.lam.3.41: Let us lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.
texts.lam.3.42: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
texts.lam.3.43: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
texts.lam.3.44: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.
texts.lam.3.45: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
texts.lam.3.46: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
texts.lam.3.47: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
texts.lam.3.48: My eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
texts.lam.3.49: My eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,
texts.lam.3.50: Till the LORD shall look down, and behold from heaven.
texts.lam.3.51: My eye affecteth my heart because of all the daughters of my city.
texts.lam.3.52: My enemies chased me fiercely, like a bird without cause.
texts.lam.3.53: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
texts.lam.3.54: Waters flowed over my head; then I said, I am cut off.
texts.lam.3.55: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.
texts.lam.3.56: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thy ear at my breathing, at my cry.
texts.lam.3.57: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
texts.lam.3.58: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
texts.lam.3.59: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
texts.lam.3.60: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.
texts.lam.3.61: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, and all their imaginations against me;
texts.lam.3.62: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
texts.lam.3.63: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their music.
texts.lam.3.64: Render to them a recompense, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
texts.lam.3.65: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse to them.
texts.lam.3.66: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
texts.lam.4.1: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.
texts.lam.4.2: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
texts.lam.4.3: Even the sea-monsters draw out the breast, they nurse their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
texts.lam.4.4: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it to them.
texts.lam.4.5: They that fed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
texts.lam.4.6: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.
texts.lam.4.7: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:
texts.lam.4.8: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.
texts.lam.4.9: They that are slain with the sword are better than they that are slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.
texts.lam.4.10: The hands of the pitiful women have boiled their own children: they were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
texts.lam.4.11: The LORD hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured her foundations.
texts.lam.4.12: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy would have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.
texts.lam.4.13: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her.
texts.lam.4.14: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.
texts.lam.4.15: They cried to them, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.
texts.lam.4.16: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favored not the elders.
texts.lam.4.17: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.
texts.lam.4.18: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.
texts.lam.4.19: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
texts.lam.4.20: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.
texts.lam.4.21: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through to thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.
texts.lam.4.22: The punishment of thy iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thy iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will disclose thy sins.
texts.lam.5.1: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
texts.lam.5.2: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
texts.lam.5.3: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.
texts.lam.5.4: We have drank our water for money; our wood is sold to us.
texts.lam.5.5: Our necks are under persecution: we labor, and have no rest.
texts.lam.5.6: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
texts.lam.5.7: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.
texts.lam.5.8: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.
texts.lam.5.9: We procured our bread with the peril of our lives, because of the sword of the wilderness.
texts.lam.5.10: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
texts.lam.5.11: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.
texts.lam.5.12: Princes were hanged by their hand: the faces of elders were not honored.
texts.lam.5.13: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
texts.lam.5.14: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their music.
texts.lam.5.15: The joy of our heart hath ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
texts.lam.5.16: The crown is fallen from our head: woe to us, that we have sinned!
texts.lam.5.17: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.
texts.lam.5.18: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.
texts.lam.5.19: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
texts.lam.5.20: Why dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?
texts.lam.5.21: Turn thou us to thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
texts.lam.5.22: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.

texts.lam.1.1: How doth the city sit solitary [that] was full of people! She that was great among the nations is become as a widow; the princess among the provinces is become tributary!
texts.lam.1.2: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks; among all her lovers she hath no comforter; all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.
texts.lam.1.3: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude; she dwelleth among the nations, she findeth no rest: all her pursuers have overtaken her within the straits.
texts.lam.1.4: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn assembly: all her gates are desolate; her priests sigh, her virgins are in grief; and as for her, she is in bitterness.
texts.lam.1.5: Her adversaries have become the head, her enemies prosper; for Jehovah hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the adversary.
texts.lam.1.6: And from the daughter of Zion all her splendour is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture; and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
texts.lam.1.7: In the days of her affliction and of her wanderings, since her people fell into the hand of an adversary, and none did help her, Jerusalem remembereth all her precious things which she had in the days of old: the adversaries have seen her, they mock at her ruin.
texts.lam.1.8: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore is she removed as an impurity: all that honoured her despise her because they have seen her nakedness; and she sigheth, and turneth backward.
texts.lam.1.9: Her impurity was in her skirts, she remembered not her latter end; and she came down wonderfully: she hath no comforter. Jehovah, behold my affliction; for the enemy hath magnified himself.
texts.lam.1.10: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her precious things; for she hath seen the nations enter into her sanctuary, concerning whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.
texts.lam.1.11: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their precious things for food to revive [their] soul. See, Jehovah, and consider, for I am become vile.
texts.lam.1.12: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? Behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, whom Jehovah hath afflicted in the day of his fierce anger.
texts.lam.1.13: From on high hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them; he hath spread a net for my feet; he hath turned me back; he hath made me desolate [and] faint all the day.
texts.lam.1.14: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, they are come up upon my neck; he hath made my strength to fail; the Lord hath delivered me into hands out of which I am not able to rise up.
texts.lam.1.15: The Lord hath cast down all my mighty men in the midst of me; he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men; the Lord hath trodden as a winepress the virgin daughter of Judah.
texts.lam.1.16: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water: for the comforter that should revive my soul is far from me; my children are desolate, for the enemy hath prevailed.
texts.lam.1.17: Zion spreadeth forth her hands; there is none to comfort her; Jehovah hath commanded concerning Jacob, [that] his adversaries [should be] round about him; Jerusalem is as an impurity among them.
texts.lam.1.18: Jehovah is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment. Hear, I pray you, all ye peoples, and behold my sorrow. My virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
texts.lam.1.19: I called for my lovers, they have deceived me; my priests and mine elders have expired in the city, while they sought them food to revive their soul.
texts.lam.1.20: See, Jehovah, for I am in distress, my bowels are troubled; my heart is turned within me, for I have grievously rebelled: without, the sword hath bereaved [me], within, it is as death.
texts.lam.1.21: They have heard that I sigh: I have no comforter: all mine enemies have heard of my calamity; they are glad that thou hast done it. Thou wilt bring the day that thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.
texts.lam.1.22: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
texts.lam.2.1: How hath the Lord in his anger covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud! He hath cast down from the heavens unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger.
texts.lam.2.2: The Lord hath swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob, and hath not spared; he hath thrown down in his wrath the strongholds of the daughter of Judah: he hath brought [them] down to the ground; he hath profaned the kingdom and the princes thereof.
texts.lam.2.3: He hath cut off in fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath withdrawn his right hand from before the enemy; and he burned up Jacob like a flaming fire, devouring round about.
texts.lam.2.4: He hath bent his bow like an enemy; he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and hath slain all that was pleasant to the eye: in the tent of the daughter of Zion, he hath poured out his fury like fire.
texts.lam.2.5: The Lord is become as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel; he hath swallowed up all her palaces; he hath destroyed his strongholds, and hath multiplied in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.
texts.lam.2.6: And he hath violently cast down his enclosure as a garden; he hath destroyed his place of assembly: Jehovah hath caused set feast and sabbath to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger king and priest.
texts.lam.2.7: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath rejected his sanctuary; he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces: they have made a noise in the house of Jehovah, as on the day of a set feast.
texts.lam.2.8: Jehovah hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out the line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying; and he hath made the rampart and the wall to lament: they languish together.
texts.lam.2.9: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars. Her king and her princes are among the nations: the law is no [more]; her prophets also find no vision from Jehovah.
texts.lam.2.10: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, they keep silence; they have cast dust upon their heads, they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their head to the ground.
texts.lam.2.11: Mine eyes are consumed with tears, my bowels are troubled; my liver is poured upon the earth, because of the ruin of the daughter of my people; because infant and suckling swoon in the streets of the city.
texts.lam.2.12: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city; when they pour out their soul into their mothers' bosom.
texts.lam.2.13: What shall I take to witness for thee? what shall I liken unto thee, daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, virgin daughter of Zion? For thy ruin is great as the sea: who will heal thee?
texts.lam.2.14: Thy prophets have seen vanity and folly for thee; and they have not revealed thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee burdens of falsehood and causes of expulsion.
texts.lam.2.15: All that pass by clap [their] hands at thee; they hiss and shake their head at the daughter of Jerusalem: Is this the city which they called, The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?
texts.lam.2.16: All thine enemies open their mouth against thee, they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed [her] up; this is forsooth the day that we looked for: we have found, we have seen [it].
texts.lam.2.17: Jehovah hath done what he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word which he had commanded from the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not spared, and he hath caused the enemy to rejoice over thee; he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.
texts.lam.2.18: Their heart cried unto the Lord. O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a torrent day and night: give thyself no respite; let not the apple of thine eye rest.
texts.lam.2.19: Arise, cry out in the night, in the beginning of the watches; pour out thy heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, who faint from hunger at the top of all the streets.
texts.lam.2.20: See, Jehovah, and consider to whom thou hast done this! Shall the women eat their fruit, the infants that they nursed? Shall priest and prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?
texts.lam.2.21: The child and the old man lie on the ground in the streets; my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword: thou hast slain [them] in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, thou hast not spared.
texts.lam.2.22: Thou hast called up, as on the day of a set feast, my terrors on every side; and in the day of Jehovah's anger there was none that escaped or remained: those that I have nursed and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.
texts.lam.3.1: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
texts.lam.3.2: Me hath he led, and brought into darkness, and not into light.
texts.lam.3.3: Surely against me hath he turned again and again his hand all the day.
texts.lam.3.4: My flesh and my skin hath he wasted away, he hath broken my bones.
texts.lam.3.5: He hath built against me, and encompassed [me] with gall and toil.
texts.lam.3.6: He hath made me to dwell in dark places as those that have been long dead.
texts.lam.3.7: He hath hedged me about that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
texts.lam.3.8: Even when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
texts.lam.3.9: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
texts.lam.3.10: He is unto me [as] a bear lying in wait, a lion in secret places.
texts.lam.3.11: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces; he hath made me desolate.
texts.lam.3.12: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
texts.lam.3.13: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
texts.lam.3.14: I am become a derision to all my people; their song all the day.
texts.lam.3.15: He hath sated me with bitterness, he hath made me drunk with wormwood.
texts.lam.3.16: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
texts.lam.3.17: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I have forgotten prosperity.
texts.lam.3.18: And I said, My strength is perished, and my hope in Jehovah.
texts.lam.3.19: Remember thou mine affliction and my wandering, the wormwood and the gall.
texts.lam.3.20: My soul hath [them] constantly in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
texts.lam.3.21: -- This I recall to heart, therefore have I hope.
texts.lam.3.22: It is of Jehovah's loving-kindness we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not;
texts.lam.3.23: they are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
texts.lam.3.24: Jehovah is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
texts.lam.3.25: Jehovah is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul [that] seeketh him.
texts.lam.3.26: It is good that one should both wait, and that in silence, for the salvation of Jehovah.
texts.lam.3.27: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth:
texts.lam.3.28: He sitteth solitary and keepeth silence, because he hath laid it upon him;
texts.lam.3.29: he putteth his mouth in the dust, if so be there may be hope;
texts.lam.3.30: he giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him; he is filled full with reproach.
texts.lam.3.31: For the Lord will not cast off for ever;
texts.lam.3.32: but if he have caused grief, he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving-kindnesses:
texts.lam.3.33: for he doth not willingly afflict or grieve the children of men.
texts.lam.3.34: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,
texts.lam.3.35: to turn aside the right of a man before the face of the Most High,
texts.lam.3.36: to wrong a man in his cause, -- will not the Lord see it?
texts.lam.3.37: Who is he that saith, and there cometh to pass, what the Lord hath not commanded?
texts.lam.3.38: Out of the mouth of the Most High doth not there proceed evil and good?
texts.lam.3.39: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
texts.lam.3.40: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to Jehovah.
texts.lam.3.41: Let us lift up our heart with [our] hands unto ùGod in the heavens.
texts.lam.3.42: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
texts.lam.3.43: Thou hast covered thyself with anger, and pursued us; thou hast slain, thou hast not spared.
texts.lam.3.44: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that prayer should not pass through.
texts.lam.3.45: Thou hast made us the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the peoples.
texts.lam.3.46: All our enemies have opened their mouth against us.
texts.lam.3.47: Fear and the pit are come upon us, devastation and ruin.
texts.lam.3.48: Mine eye runneth down with streams of water for the ruin of the daughter of my people.
texts.lam.3.49: Mine eye poureth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,
texts.lam.3.50: till Jehovah look down and behold from the heavens.
texts.lam.3.51: Mine eye affecteth my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.
texts.lam.3.52: They that are mine enemies without cause have chased me sore like a bird.
texts.lam.3.53: They have cut off my life in a pit, and cast a stone upon me.
texts.lam.3.54: Waters streamed over my head; I said, I am cut off.
texts.lam.3.55: I called upon thy name, Jehovah, out of the lowest pit.
texts.lam.3.56: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my sighing, at my cry.
texts.lam.3.57: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee; thou saidst, Fear not.
texts.lam.3.58: Lord, thou hast pleaded the cause of my soul, thou hast redeemed my life.
texts.lam.3.59: Jehovah, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
texts.lam.3.60: Thou hast seen all their vengeance, all their imaginations against me.
texts.lam.3.61: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Jehovah, all their imaginations against me;
texts.lam.3.62: the lips of those that rise up against me and their meditation against me all the day.
texts.lam.3.63: Behold thou their sitting down and their rising up: I am their song.
texts.lam.3.64: Render unto them a recompence, O Jehovah, according to the work of their hands;
texts.lam.3.65: give them obduracy of heart, thy curse unto them;
texts.lam.3.66: pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of Jehovah.
texts.lam.4.1: How is the gold become dim! the most pure gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary poured out at the top of all the streets!
texts.lam.4.2: The sons of Zion, so precious, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
texts.lam.4.3: Even the jackals offer the breast, they give suck to their young; the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
texts.lam.4.4: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst; the young children ask bread, no man breaketh it unto them.
texts.lam.4.5: They that fed delicately are desolate in the streets; they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dung-hills.
texts.lam.4.6: And the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the reward of the sin of Sodom, which was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands were violently laid upon her.
texts.lam.4.7: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, whiter than milk; they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their figure was as sapphire.
texts.lam.4.8: Their visage is darker than blackness, they are not known in the streets; their skin cleaveth to their bones, it is withered, it is become like a stick.
texts.lam.4.9: The slain with the sword are happier than the slain with hunger; for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.
texts.lam.4.10: The hands of pitiful women have boiled their own children: they were their meat in the ruin of the daughter of my people.
texts.lam.4.11: Jehovah hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, which hath consumed the foundations thereof.
texts.lam.4.12: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should enter into the gates of Jerusalem.
texts.lam.4.13: [It is] for the sins of her prophets, [and] the iniquities of her priests, who have shed the blood of the righteous in the midst of her.
texts.lam.4.14: They wandered about blind in the streets; they were polluted with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.
texts.lam.4.15: They cried unto them, Depart! Unclean! Depart! depart, touch not! When they fled away, and wandered about, it was said among the nations, They shall no more sojourn [there].
texts.lam.4.16: The face of Jehovah hath divided them; he will no more regard them. They respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the aged.
texts.lam.4.17: Our eyes still failed for our vain help; in our watching, we have watched for a nation that did not save.
texts.lam.4.18: They hunted our steps, that we could not go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.
texts.lam.4.19: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles of the heavens; they chased us hotly upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
texts.lam.4.20: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of Jehovah, was taken in their pits; of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the nations.
texts.lam.4.21: Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz: the cup shall pass also unto thee; thou shalt be drunken, and make thyself naked.
texts.lam.4.22: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity. He will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.
texts.lam.5.1: Remember, O Jehovah, what is come upon us; consider, and see our reproach.
texts.lam.5.2: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
texts.lam.5.3: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.
texts.lam.5.4: Our water have we to drink for money, our wood cometh unto us for a price.
texts.lam.5.5: Our pursuers are on our necks: we are weary, we have no rest.
texts.lam.5.6: We have given the hand to Egypt, [and] to Asshur, to be satisfied with bread.
texts.lam.5.7: Our fathers have sinned, [and] they are not; and we bear their iniquities.
texts.lam.5.8: Bondmen rule over us: there is no deliverer out of their hand.
texts.lam.5.9: We have to get our bread at the risk of our lives, because of the sword of the wilderness.
texts.lam.5.10: Our skin gloweth like an oven, because of the burning heat of the famine.
texts.lam.5.11: They have ravished the women in Zion, the maids in the cities of Judah.
texts.lam.5.12: Princes were hanged up by their hand; the faces of elders were not honoured.
texts.lam.5.13: The young men have borne the mill, and the youths have stumbled under the wood.
texts.lam.5.14: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their music.
texts.lam.5.15: The joy of our heart hath ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
texts.lam.5.16: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, for we have sinned!
texts.lam.5.17: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes have grown dim,
texts.lam.5.18: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate: foxes walk over it.
texts.lam.5.19: Thou, Jehovah, dwellest for ever; thy throne is from generation to generation.
texts.lam.5.20: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, dost thou forsake us so long time?
texts.lam.5.21: Turn thou us unto thee, Jehovah, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
texts.lam.5.22: Or is it that thou hast utterly rejected us? Wouldest thou be exceeding wroth against us?

texts.lam.1.1: How hath she sat alone, The city abounding with people! She hath been as a widow, The mighty among nations! Princes among provinces, She hath become tributary!
texts.lam.1.2: She weepeth sore in the night, And her tear [is] on her cheeks, There is no comforter for her out of all her lovers, All her friends dealt treacherously by her, They have been to her for enemies.
texts.lam.1.3: Removed hath Judah because of affliction, And because of the abundance of her service; She hath dwelt among nations, She hath not found rest, All her pursuers have overtaken her between the straits.
texts.lam.1.4: The ways of Zion are mourning, Without any coming at the appointed time, All her gates are desolate, her priests sigh, Her virgins are afflicted -- and she hath bitterness.
texts.lam.1.5: Her adversaries have become chief, Her enemies have been at ease, For Jehovah hath afflicted her, For the abundance of her transgressions, Her infants have gone captive before the adversary.
texts.lam.1.6: And go out from the daughter of Zion doth all her honour, Her princes have been as harts -- They have not found pasture, And they go powerless before a pursuer.
